response.original_title: The X-Files: I Want to Believe – Vrach Frankenshteyn
response.overview: Chris Carter’s Vrach Frankenshteyn cut features the same core plot as the original theatrical release—with Mulder and Scully pulled back into the FBI by a disgraced, psychic priest (Father Joe) to investigate the kidnapping of women. However, this version restores Carter's original, grislier medical gore and darker tone
